role: Sole sequencing source for the private implementation estate. Owns stage identity, the ordered dependency graph, stage exit gates, reusable-module bindings, mandatory rails, and the release/claim ladder.
does_not_own: architecture doctrine or canonical object meaning (docs/architecture and accepted ADRs own that)
durable cut status (the owning work-item record owns that)
current orientation (NOW.md and generated/program-state.v1.json project it)
insertion_rule: Stage, module, rail, and claim-level identifiers are stable strings. Order is derived by topological sort over depends_on, never by array position or by renumbering. A new stage, substage, obligation, or gate is added by appending one entry and naming its depends_on edges; no existing identifier changes.

stages.objective: Freeze what may be claimed, prove the program-control model, and lock the claim ladder before any product stage advances.
nonclaims: Program control is workflow evidence and grants no product authority.

differential_lanes.title: Direct non-System M3 entry lane
differential_lanes.scope: Schema admission, executable admission-path selection, and immutable pursuit-definition resolution for one bounded direct non-System GoalRun.
nonclaims: The M3 stage is not open or complete merely because this lane is permitted.
System-bound GoalRun work still requires current unqualified M1 and M2 exits.
This lane does not close P0, admit collective pursuit, or satisfy the M3 aggregate exit.

stages.notes: Direct non-System work may proceed on the M3 direct path without a verified M1-M2 System binding; the System-bound path may not.

stages.title: Conditional Future Work
stages.objective: Hold canonically required work whose activation depends on a named external condition rather than on a stage predecessor.
stages.activation_rule: A FUTURE record activates only when its named external condition is satisfied and the sequence graph gains an explicit depends_on edge for it. It is never scheduled by elapsed time.

claim_ladder.title: walking skeleton
claim_ladder.honest_minimum_claim: One fixture traverses selected owner boundaries; not production-ready.

claim_ladder.title: internal product proof
claim_ladder.honest_minimum_claim: Terminal M9 journey works with adversarial evidence in an IOI-controlled environment.

claim_ladder.title: external design-partner proof
claim_ladder.honest_minimum_claim: Independent users complete the journey on their data with disclosed support and limits.

claim_ladder.title: production-integrated profile
claim_ladder.honest_minimum_claim: Applicable required_now and selected conditional gates close; SRE/recovery thresholds pass.

claim_ladder.title: distributed L0 proof
claim_ladder.honest_minimum_claim: One logical System preserves continuity and performs useful work across admitted nodes.

claim_ladder.title: sovereign cooperation proof
claim_ladder.honest_minimum_claim: Independently governed Systems demonstrate useful positive-surplus work and portable exit.

claim_ladder.title: embodied deployment proof
claim_ladder.honest_minimum_claim: Selected live hardware profile passes Physical Action Safety, Embodied Runtime, and production gates.

claim_ladder.title: public network demand proof
claim_ladder.honest_minimum_claim: Connected/secured services show recurring external demand and sustainable security economics.

claim_ladder_rule: The ladder is evidence-monotonic, not permanently monotonic. A failed reverification, incident, revoked source, compromised key, changed dependency, or lost assurance input narrows the current claim immediately.

stage_states.pending: Prerequisites or activation decision not yet satisfied.
stage_states.active: At least one admitted work item is executing.
stage_states.evidence_ready: Positive path exists; adversarial and release evidence is under review.
stage_states.verified: The stage exit proof and required rails close.
stage_states.blocked: A named external decision, authority, dependency, or environment prevents progress.
stage_states.superseded: Canon changed the stage; evidence is retained and this file is revised.

stage_state_rule: Only proof changes a stage to verified. Stage state is derived from the owning aggregate_exit work-item record, never asserted here.
